summary: iter251 Phase 2 DVIR · frontend-only review. Verified driver-facing DVIR form, three confirmation outcomes (🟢 clear / 🟡 monitor / 🔴 OOS), bilingual EN/ES, mobile/tablet viewports, tile placement, validation, trailer add/remove, severity version pill, calm operator tone. ONE CRITICAL console bug found: 1682 duplicate-key warnings from <option key={unit_number}> when many units have empty unit_number. Everything else works as specified.

ui_bugs.issue: React warning floods console: 'Encountered two children with the same key' — 1682 occurrences. Root cause: <option key={u.unit_number}> at lines 548 & 643 in /app/frontend/src/pages/NewFleetDVIR.jsx; backend /api/fleet/units returns ~60 units with empty unit_number (out of 149), so empty string is used as React key for many siblings. Fix: change key to u.id (which is unique UUID) and optionally filter out units with no unit_number from the dropdown so drivers cannot pick a blank truck. Currently the truck list shows blank entries that auto-fill no plate/VIN.

Spec asks for data-testid='severity-rationale' but actual rendered testid is 'helptip-severity-rationale' (HelpTip wraps testId prefix). HelpTip renders correctly with calm language ('Safety-critical for road operation...') when FAIL is selected — content & tone confirmed. Just a testid naming mismatch; either update spec or wrap HelpTip in a div with data-testid='severity-rationale'.
Sporadic React DOM warning '<span> cannot be a child of option' in console. Did not visibly break the dropdown. Likely from sibling component, low priority but worth a sweep.

verified_passing: /field shows 'Trucking · Daily DVIR' tile (data-testid='field-tile-dvir') linking to /fleet/dvir/new
GET /fleet/dvir/new renders 4 sections (Driver & Truck · Truck Walk-Around · Trailer Walk-Around · Sign & Submit)
Validation: submit blocked with calm message until driver_name, truck, all 83 items, signature, and 10+ char defect notes are supplied
PASS/FAIL/NA buttons are 44px tall (meets ≥44px gloves spec); PASS emerald, FAIL amber (NOT red), NA slate — operator philosophy honored
FAIL toggle reveals defect note + PhotoUpload + 'Why this matters' HelpTip with calm rationale ('Safety-critical for road operation or worker protection...') — no scary compliance jargon
Truck dropdown loads 97 trucks from /api/fleet/units; selecting auto-fills plate + VIN
Add trailer button reveals 24 trailer checklist items; trailer remove (X) button works
All-PASS submission → /fleet/dvir/submitted/:id renders 🟢 'All Clear · Ready to Roll' (emerald) — verified visually
Service-brakes FAIL submission → 🔴 'Out of Service · Repair required before return to service' (red-700) with the failed item listed under 'Logged for Shop' plus driver's note — verified visually
Tire minor sidewall scuff FAIL → 🟡 'Defect Logged · Truck Still Available' (amber-600) — verified visually
Confirmation page chips: Truck, Defects count, Status (Out of Service / Defect Logged / Available), Driver — all render
Confirmation CTAs present and correct: 'Start another DVIR' → /fleet/dvir/new · 'Back to Field' → /field · 'Home' → /

Bilingual ES: clicking [data-testid='lang-es'] persists lang=es in localStorage; all DVIR labels translate (Nombre del conductor, Unidad de camión, Firmar y Enviar, Enviar DVIR, Inspección Diaria del Vehículo, Conductor y Camión, Recorrido del Camión, etc.) — ZERO English leakage on DVIR pages in ES mode
Mobile 414×900 (iPhone): no horizontal scroll (sw=414, cw=414), no overflow, checklist row layout flows cleanly
Tablet portrait 768×1024 (iPad): no horizontal scroll, 2-col date/time grid renders
Tablet landscape 1024×768 (iPad): no horizontal scroll, form readable
Offline indicator code wired via window 'online'/'offline' listeners (data-testid='dvir-offline-indicator')
Calm tone audit: NO 'NONCOMPLIANT', 'FAILED SAFETY INSPECTION', 'VIOLATION', or 'UNSAFE' language anywhere on form or confirmation
action_items: FIX (HIGH): change <option key={u.unit_number}> to <option key={u.id}> on lines 548 and 643 of /app/frontend/src/pages/NewFleetDVIR.jsx — eliminates 1682 duplicate-key React warnings.

RECOMMEND: also filter the truck/trailer dropdowns to units where unit_number is non-empty (currently blank entries appear in the dropdown options, e.g. '— 2015 Garmin 465 LMT' with no unit number). Or backend should not return units with missing unit_number from /api/fleet/units.
OPTIONAL: rename HelpTip wrapper testid for severity rationale to match spec ('severity-rationale' instead of derived 'helptip-severity-rationale') OR update spec wording.
OPTIONAL: investigate '<span> cannot be a child of option' hydration warning.
critical_code_review_comments: Duplicate React keys in <select> options is a real correctness bug — when keys collide React may render stale option labels or skip updates. Must use u.id (UUID) as key.

Severity hint table in NewFleetDVIR.jsx (lines 217-248) is a long string-includes list — drift risk vs. server SOT. Long-term consider exposing per-item severity in /api/fleet/_meta so the FAIL-time rationale uses server data, not duplicated client tokens.
Backend exposes ~60 fleet units with empty unit_number — these pollute the driver dropdown. Either filter on backend or in the React select.
PhotoUpload + SignaturePad reuse from existing components — good, fully native to MASCI platform.
No console errors other than the duplicate-key flood and the minor hydration warning — overall implementation is clean.
test_credentials: None needed — DVIR is anonymously submittable per operator D2 decision.
seed_data_creation: Submitted 3 anonymous DVIRs (TEST Driver Clear / TEST Driver OOS / TEST Driver Monitor) against trucks DPT002-6387, DPT007-8803, DPT014-7057. Each creates rows in equipment_inspections, fleet_defects, fleet_status, fleet_audit by truck_unit_number — main agent should run the documented cleanup (delete by truck_unit_number in those 3 units) before deploying to keep the live dispatch board clean. Reference IDs visible on screenshots #A7AD891B and #1D0036D2.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 2 frontend is functionally complete. Only blocker to ship is the React duplicate-key flood from the truck/trailer <option> keys (use u.id). After main agent fixes that one-line change + filters empty unit_numbers, this DVIR surface is shippable. ES mode confirmed zero-leakage. All three outcomes (clear/monitor/oos) render with calm operator tone — screenshots saved at .screenshots/oos.png, .screenshots/monitor.png, .screenshots/es_mode.png. SignaturePad in Playwright must be drawn via dispatched PointerEvents (mouse.down/move/up alone does not fire onEnd on the react-signature-canvas library in this build).
rca of the issue: Duplicate React key warnings: /api/fleet/units returns ~60 of 149 units with unit_number=''; <option key={u.unit_number}> in NewFleetDVIR.jsx lines 548 (truck) + 643 (trailer) collide on empty string. Fix: key={u.id}. Repro: open /fleet/dvir/new in dev console — see 'Encountered two children with the same key, \'\''.
